extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: single-drum road roller (approx. 11 t), approx. 5.7 x 2.4 x 3.1 m (L x W x H), drum 1.5 m diameter x 2.1 m wide, rear tyres 1.4 m
extras.notes: front (drum) faces -Y; the steel drum 'road-roller_drum' is a separate object with its origin on the drum axle (rotate around local X to roll); the two rear tyres are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X); open operator station under a protective canopy; amber beacon glows softly; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
